author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಉಪಯೋಗವೇನಿಹುದು ಜಾತಿಮತ ಮುಖ್ಯವೆನೆ
ಉಪಲಬ್ಧ ಸತ್ಯಗಳು ಜಗಳದಲಿ ಲುಪ್ತ
ಉಪಭೋಗಿಯರಿತೊಡನೆ ಧರ್ಮವೊಂದಿಹುದೆಂದು
ಅಪಕಾರ ನಶಿಸುವುದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: What use is there if caste and creed are made the main thing?
the truths we have are lost in quarrels;
once the one who enjoys life knows that dharma is one,
en.bhavartha: Putting caste and creed first leads only to quarrels in which truth is lost. Once we understand that dharma is one, harm and hostility fade.
